answer_2.quote: We adopt a widely-used metric -Attack Success Rate (ASR) -and design a new metric -Non-Detectable Attack Success Rate (NASR) -to evaluate attack performance. We also report the Percentage of Perturbed Words (%Words) and Semantic Similarity (SS)...

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluations to assess the adversarial examples generated by DA 3... Grammar correctness is scored from 1-5. Then, human judges assess the semantic preservation of adversarial examples, determining whether they maintain the original semantics.
answer_4.guideline: Grammar correctness is scored from 1-5. Semantic preservation is classified as similar (1), ambiguous (0.5), or dissimilar (0).
